author: Jeanette L. McBride and Marlin L. Bowles

access_notes: greenmapping.org returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to automated retrieval on 2026-08-10 and the Wayback availability API returned 429, so this record is bibliographic only: it was NOT read at its locator in this session. note: The primary quantitative authority for presettlement vegetation structure in the Chicago region: landscape-type percentages, bearing-tree and line-tree species tables, Cottam and Curtis tree-density classes, undergrowth vocabulary, American hazel as the dominant shrub layer, the willow thickets unique to Cook County, and the 1821 J. Walls note 'First part of this mile a swampy timber thicket' on the section 4-5 line of T39N R14E.
